Kavya Mehta
Senior Financial Analyst | Hyderabad, Telangana
kavya.mehta871@example.com | +91 9145455035

Senior Financial Analyst with strong FP&A and financial modeling background supporting fast-growing education and technology businesses. Skilled in translating business strategy into actionable forecasts, visual dashboards, and cost-optimization initiatives. Open to relocating to Chennai. Notice period: 30 days.

Experience

Kite Learning — Nov 2022 - Present
Senior Financial Analyst (Onsite)
- Built and maintained dynamic financial models and rolling forecasts using Financial Modelling and MS Excel to support quarterly planning; reduced forecast variance from 9% to 3% within 12 months.
- Designed Power BI dashboards to consolidate revenue, cohort KPIs, and CAC metrics, enabling leadership to identify a 15% improvement opportunity in marketing spend allocation.
- Led FP&A processes for monthly close and management reporting, standardizing templates and decreasing report preparation time by 40%.
- Implemented Agile cadence for cross-functional planning cycles, running bi-weekly sprint reviews with product and sales teams to align forecasts with roadmap changes.

Ola — Oct 2022 - Oct 2022
Financial Analyst (Contract)
- Supported a short-term FP&A engagement to accelerate monthly close, reconciling key revenue streams and expense drivers using MS Excel and Financial Modelling techniques.
- Produced Power BI visualizations summarizing driver-based scenarios for pricing and promotions, contributing to an executive decision that optimized unit economics by ~4%.
- Developed templated variance analysis reports that improved visibility into month-over-month margin shifts for the transportation vertical.

Pixelwave Studios — Oct 2020 - Sep 2022
Financial Analyst (Hybrid)
- Owned FP&A for multiple game titles, creating Financial Modelling frameworks in MS Excel to forecast revenue, live-ops spend, and player LTV; forecasts informed a reallocation that increased high-performing title investment by 20%.
- Implemented Power BI reporting to track daily active users to revenue conversion, producing executive dashboards used in weekly product reviews.
- Partnered with product and marketing teams in an Agile working model to iterate on monetization experiments; tracked cohort performance and adjusted forecasts, improving forecast accuracy by 25%.

Projects
- Subscription Pricing Test: Designed scenario models and Power BI dashboards to evaluate three subscription pricing tiers; recommended a tiered rollout that projected a 12% revenue uplift in the first 6 months.
- Cost Optimization Tracker: Created an MS Excel-based tracker and Power BI scorecard to monitor vendor spend and identify savings opportunities; implemented changes yielding a 7% reduction in operating expenses.

Skills
Financial Modelling, FP&A, MS Excel
Power BI, Agile

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
